pending_part_2.description: PART 2 (FINALE): High-tech deep sonar reveals what lies at the bottom of the Money Pit. #shorts #viral #mystery
pending_part_2.voiceover_script: In Part 1, we saw how an ingenious tidal booby trap protected the legendary Oak Island shaft for centuries. Over six men have lost their lives trying to breach its depths. But recently, heavy drilling rigs and deep seismic tomography penetrated two hundred feet through solid bedrock, and what they discovered shocked geologists worldwide. Scanners detected human bone fragments, sixteenth-century Spanish copper coins, and parchment paper containing traces of gold leaf. Even more unbelievable, bore-hole cameras captured what appears to be a vaulted wooden chamber reinforced with iron hinges. Who possessed the advanced engineering skills to construct a complex hydraulic vault centuries before modern machinery? Some secrets were never meant to surface.
